title: Literal AC 'motion strip captures at 100 ms show continuous progression' is unsatisfiable — evidence substituted with 60 Hz (17 ms) captures
evidence: Briefing acceptance: "Sub-tick interpolation live; packets glide between ticks (motion strip captures at 100 ms show continuous progression, no 50 ms jumps)."  Diff field notes: "motion strips must render mid-tick (25ms/16.7ms cadence), not tick-aligned (100ms) — a 100ms strip samples only tick boundaries and shows the same stepping in both modes; the 60Hz displacement table is the decisive before/after proof."  PR body reproduce: "./bin/harness motion-strip motion 2200 2600 17 bin/m60-before snapshot"
detail: No artifact demonstrates the AC as written: 100 ms cadence is tick-aligned (2×50 ms) and steps identically before/after. The intent is met by the 17 ms strip + displacement table (21/24→10/24 holds, 30.6→11.2 px), and the deviation is documented.
recommended_fix: Amend the acceptance line to '60 Hz (17 ms cadence) strip captures show continuous progression'; drop or re-caption the 100 ms juice strips in the PR reproduce block.
